svg.aria-label: Four disaster-recovery strategies from cheapest to most resilient. Backup and restore: copy backups to another region; recovery takes hours and you lose data since the last backup. Pilot light: data is replicated continuously to a second region but servers are off; recovery in tens of minutes. Warm standby: a scaled-down full copy runs in the second region; recovery in minutes. Active-active: both regions serve traffic all the time; a region loss costs seconds and almost no data, but writes need conflict handling or a global database, and cost is roughly double.

svg.text: cost and complexity grow to the right; downtime and data loss shrink
